description: Marion, IA – Ashley Hinson launched a new ad for the general election today, “Squeezed.” The ad is set to air on broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms across Iowa. [Watch Here] “Prices are up everywhere, and families are getting squeezed. I’m working with both parties to put the squeeze on Big Pharma and Big Health Insurance companies to bring down premiums and drug prices. We eliminated taxes on tips and overtime, and we cut taxes on Social Security. But there is so much more work to do, and I’ll be a bipartisan fighter to lower costs and make life more affordable for Iowans.” Hinson’s work to lower costs for Iowans: ###

title: Hinson Releases New Ad: “Squeezed” - Ashley Hinson for Iowa
